definitions.explanation: The act of keeping skin or other surfaces moist. Primarily used in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保湿|ほしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{保湿|ほしつ}⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れている→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: This moisturizing cream is selling well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{保湿|ほしつ}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: If you don't moisturize properly after washing your face, your skin will dry out.

notes:
A compound of {保|ほ} (preserve) and {湿|しつ} (moisture). Almost always used in skincare and beauty contexts to refer to keeping skin hydrated.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保湿|ほしつ}⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: moisturizing cream
- {保湿|ほしつ}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: moisturizing ingredients
- {保湿|ほしつ}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: moisturizing care/routine
- {保湿|ほしつ}{力|りょく}: moisturizing power
- {保湿|ほしつ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: moisturizing effect
- {保湿|ほしつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to moisturize (suru verb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: dryness, drying out — the opposite condition
- ⟦{潤|うるお}い→潤い：08250_uruoi⟧: moisture, hydration — the desired result

USAGE:
Particularly relevant in ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter) when ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (dryness) is a common concern. Skincare routines in Japan typically emphasize {保湿|ほしつ} as a key step after ⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧ (face washing).
